borrowed_storage_contract: NativeShadowMapView retains existing SystemShadowMapOwner references for +144/+184/+1C4/+204 matrices, +38 direction, and +390 limits; no copies.
NativeShadowMapView binds the SAME raw global slot 00F8BBF0 and SAME actual shadow +384 fallback slot. It does not own a cached texture or global target value.
NativeShadowDepthTargetFields binds actual target +04 width, +08 height, +0C enable, +0D created/capability, raw +10 color and raw +18 depth textures.
NativeD3D9ShadowTexture binds actual wrapper current vtable and SAME mutable reported DWORDs +28/+2C consumed and written by B3CE50/B3CE60/B3CEB0.
Resolver is a nonmutating exact-identity binding lookup. It cannot invoke callbacks, retain, create, or substitute a fabricated owner. It must return nullptr when the actual identity is unavailable.
Observed profiles required by host: target D5B5E8 and texture D61948. Wrong or missing identity/profile fails explicitly. Current texture profile is checked again on dimension dispatch.
Raw target leaf getters return the borrowed native pointer value. Shadow getters resolve nonnull selected pointers to concrete bindings; selected null remains null for caller handling.
Construction and destruction of the C++ companions do not initialize, allocate, free, retain, or release native owners or textures.

Disabled branch calls color setter (8,8), reloads depth identity, calls depth setter (8,8); no intervening capability check.

uncertainty_and_limits: Names are descriptive hypotheses. This packet supplies only the eight observed access/metadata routines and concrete borrowed profiles.
Host binding checks introduce explicit unavailable/unsupported errors; native routines dereference raw pointers without those guards.
Caller must provide correctly aligned live fields at the actual native offsets and nonmutating resolver lookups. Reference provenance cannot be validated by this API.
Single-threaded valid bindings only. Concurrent mutation and invalid native pointers are not modeled.
Errors are not transactional: prior native-ordered enable or first-wrapper writes remain applied if a later binding fails.

No shadow owner/global target/texture allocation, construction, deletion, refcount, COM creation, full rendering update, matrix initialization, or fallback texture loading is reconstructed by this packet.
No game execution, injected code, installed binary modification, Direct3D rendering, pixel comparison, or visual parity claim.
No drop-in native ABI compatibility claim; native fixture ABI invocation and host C++ behavioral reconstruction are separate evidence categories.
